name: WNBA_R1B2_METRIC_MECHANICS_SPEC_V1

metric_definitions.selected_side_label: y=1 iff selectedTeamId == winnerTeamId; else y=0
metric_definitions.selected_side_probability: p=p_win_selected_side from the frozen probability rowset
metric_definitions.log_loss: -mean(y*ln(p)+(1-y)*ln(1-p)); frozen probabilities are already strictly inside (0,1), so no post-hoc clipping is applied
metric_definitions.ece10: sum_b (n_b/N)*abs(mean(p in b)-mean(y in b)) over fixed bins [0,.1),[.1,.2),...,[.8,.9),[.9,1.0]; p=1.0, if ever present, belongs to the last bin
metric_definitions.season_stability: report the same selected-side accuracy, Brier, log loss, ECE10, mean predicted-minus-observed and calibration abs Z separately for each frozen season; no new season-level pass threshold is introduced

walk_forward_climatology.selected_side_conversion: For each target row, baseline p_selected = q_home when selectedSide=HOME; otherwise 1-q_home.
walk_forward_climatology.baseline_log_loss: binary log loss using p_selected_baseline and y over all 1143 rows

forbidden: dropping seasons or rows based on results
